prerequisite: Lay a fixed-width channel network inside closed boundary outlines and turn the remaining land into filleted parcels; centrelines are first smoothed with the GY command (G1 tangent)
fixture_requirements: >= 2 closed outer rings (verifies automatic grouping of several outer rings) + at least one island hole (depth 1) + one depth-2 leftover (verifies the ignore list)

Centrelines including: pure straight lines, arcs (R much larger than half width), ends touching the edge (verifies automatic extension), dead ends deep inside the region (verifies no extension), millimetre-scale fragments
An outer ring whose ends coincide but Closed=false (verifies IsSnapClosed adoption)
assertions: In-memory change only: results must be kept with an explicit save_dwg (headless apply must throw; use the out sibling file and swap)
At least one of layer/handles must be given for both boundary and centerline, otherwise throw
If any centreline fails to form a band, throw and draw nothing (better no output than a wrong drawing)
If no parcel at all is produced, throw (no quiet success)
clear_previous is idempotent: a rerun first clears old polylines on out_layer and reports cleared_previous
Boundaries at depth >= 2 go to ignored_boundaries and take no part in the boolean operations
Centrelines whose midpoint falls in no outer ring go to unassigned_centerlines, never dropped silently
Parcels smaller than min_area are still drawn; handle + area go to small_parcels
Parcels whose corners cannot take fillet_r are named in warnings (after halving 6 times the sharp corner is kept)
Source boundaries and centrelines are not touched
